source.method: Live Win32 input + WM_COMMAND + ExtendScript comp state dump + MSAA modal dialog capture

keyRules.newLayerTiming: All 7 new layer types span full comp (inPoint=0, outPoint=comp.duration, startTime=0), regardless of current playhead time.
keyRules.newLayerInsertionIndex: 0 selected -> index 1 (top); single L_k selected -> index k (directly above L_k); multi-select -> directly above topmost selected layer. Selection resets to ONLY the newly created layer.
keyRules.nullLayerDefaults: 100x100 solid with anchorPoint=[0,0,0] (top-left, NOT [50,50]), position=compCenter, opacity=0, label=1.
keyRules.adjustmentLayerDefaults: comp-sized solid with anchorPoint=compCenter, position=compCenter, opacity=100, label=5.
keyRules.cameraDefaults: CameraLayer, label=4, POI/anchorPoint=compCenter, position=[cx, cy, -zoom] where zoom = comp.width * focalLength / filmSize; Depth of Field off (0), Blur Level 100.
keyRules.lightDefaults: LightLayer (default Spot), label=6, POI/anchorPoint=compCenter, position=[cx+80, cy-80, -666.66667], Intensity=100, Color=[1,1,1,1], ConeAngle=90, ConeFeather=50, Falloff=None(1), CastsShadows=0.
keyRules.duplicateLayer: Ctrl+D (cmd 196624) inserts duplicate directly ABOVE the original (at original index, shifting original down by 1) and selects only the new duplicate.
keyRules.splitLayer: Ctrl+Shift+D (cmd 196625) keeps lower/earlier half at original index+1 (outPoint=playhead, unselected) and places new upper/later half directly ABOVE at original index (inPoint=playhead, selected). Both halves retain ALL keyframes (including outside trimmed span) and ALL effects.
keyRules.oneFrameInclusiveEndRule: N (work area end), ']' (align layer out), and Alt+] (trim layer out) are ALL 1-frame inclusive: end = playhead + 1/fps so the frame at the playhead remains visible. B, '[', and Alt+[ align exactly to playhead.
keyRules.trimCompToWorkArea: Ctrl+Shift+X (cmd 327685) sets comp.duration = workAreaDuration, workAreaStart = 0, shifts every layer's startTime by -oldWorkAreaStart, and clamps inPoint/outPoint to [0, newDuration].
keyRules.keyframeEasingDefaults: Linear default temporal influence = 16.66667% (1/6). Easy Ease (F9) sets both sides to BEZIER {speed:0, influence:33.33333} (1/3). Shift+F9 affects in-side only; Ctrl+Shift+F9 affects out-side only. Ctrl+Alt+H sets outInterp=HOLD (inInterp unchanged).
keyRules.keyframeAltTimeScaling: Alt MUST be held BEFORE mouse-down on the first or last keyframe of a multi-keyframe selection to enter proportional time-scaling anchored at the opposite end; pressing Alt after drag start keeps rigid translation.
keyRules.keyframeNudge: Alt+Left/Right nudges selected keyframes by +/-1 frame; Alt+Shift+Left/Right nudges by +/-10 frames.
keyRules.projectDragAndDrop: Project -> Comp Viewer places layer(s) at exact drop coordinate (in comp space); Project -> Timeline always centers layer(s) at comp center [cx, cy] and inserts at the drop slot (empty/between/bottom). Multi-select preserves Project list order top-to-bottom and selects all dropped layers.
keyRules.effectsStackOrder: Applying an effect appends it to the BOTTOM of the layer's Effects stack (index 1 = first applied, index 2 = second applied) with enabled=true. Multi-layer selection applies the effect to every selected layer; 0 layers selected is a no-op.
